title: making my cottage fit for a fairy
en: With stubborn conviction, I have decided it is time to prepare for spring. Though it will be many weeks before the snow is completely gone, at least I can make plans, do some late winter cleaning, and enjoy the anticipation of a new season. Though it is still winter, the usually icy morning smell is more subdued. The roads are starting to get muddy and change is in the air. Today I'm cutting the last of the winter

squash and composting the seeds. I've eaten so many squash seeds this year that I don't think I'll be able to eat more for a long while. Thankfully, they can help feed my future garden. The coming month is a busy time. There

is much to be done. I'm patiently waiting my seed catalog and will be sharing my ambitious garden plans very soon. By the end of winter, I usually find that a reorganization and tidy of my home is in order. During the dark days, I often let little tasks go undone, having felt a bit sluggish during my hibernation. But now, the sun is shining a little brighter. Winter is ever slowly
receding, and I of course am very excited. When I lived in the city, while I was

aware of the seasons, I didn't experience them in the same way I do now. I noticed the cold weather and the turning of the leaves, but that was usually about it. Out here, it is a very different experience. I observe the coyote's winter mating season. The way the deer wander much closer to my home in January in search of food. The usually rotund little quail are looking thin this time of year since so much of their body weight has been absorbed simply to keep them warm and alive. The February full moon is known as the hunger moon, representing the scarcity

animals and groups of people often experienced at this time when their reserves ran out. I find this particular full moon very impactful, causing me to reflect on the challenges that those before me went through. It makes me grateful for what I have and inspires me to continue making little choices every day to simplify my life, reuse items, and reduce my waste. It feels like not only a way to show my love to the earth, but also to show reverence to others by consuming only what I need to live comfortably. For example, I love decorating my home. Instead of immediately buying a new item, I look for secondhand decorations or in this case make my own. The result is usually very unique and special to
zh: 带着顽强的信念，我决定是时候为春天做好准备了。尽管雪还需要几周的时间才能完全消失，但至少我可以制定计划，做一些冬末的清洁工作，并享受对新季节的期待。尽管仍是冬天，但通常冰冷的早晨气味却更加柔和。道路开始变得泥泞，空气中也弥漫着变化的气息。今天我要剪掉冬天的最后一个
压碎种子并将其堆肥。今年我吃了太多的南瓜子，我想我在很长一段时间内都吃不了更多了。值得庆幸的是，它们可以帮助养活我未来的花园。接下来的一个月是忙碌的时期。那里
还有很多工作要做。我正在耐心等待我的种子目录，并将很快分享我雄心勃勃的花园计划。到冬天结束时，我通常会发现我的家已经重新整理和整洁了。在黑暗的日子里，我经常让一些小任务被取消，因为我在冬眠期间感觉有点呆滞。但现在，阳光明媚了一些。冬天总是那么缓慢
退去，我当然很兴奋。当我住在城市的时候，当我
意识到季节，我并没有像现在那样体验它们。我注意到寒冷的天气和树叶的转动，但通常仅此而已。在这里，这是一种非常不同的体验。我观察土狼的冬季交配季节。一月份，鹿在离我家更近的地方徘徊寻找食物。通常圆滚滚的小鹌鹑在每年的这个时候看起来都很瘦，因为它们的大部分体重都被吸收了，只是为了让它们保持温暖和活力。二月的满月被称为饥饿月，代表匮乏

动物和人群经常会在这个时候经历他们的储备耗尽的情况。我发现这个特别的满月非常有影响力，让我反思我之前的人所经历的挑战。它让我感激我所拥有的一切，并激励我继续每天做出一些小选择来简化我的生活、重复利用物品并减少浪费。这感觉不仅是一种表达我对地球的爱的方式，也是通过只消费我舒适生活所需的东西来表达对他人的尊重。例如，我喜欢装饰我的家。我不会立即购买新物品，而是寻找二手装饰品，或者在这种情况下自己制作。结果通常是非常独特和特殊的
